text: 2026-09-17, from the UI-X6 measurement (M3 Max, OpenJDK 25, 100 trials): per-trial estimation steps stay under 100 ms for grids up to 256x256 with Gaussian sigma up to 32 cells (sigma 32: 19.6 ms step, 17.2 ms cancellation); 512x512 at sigma 32 sits at the limit (98.6 ms); 1024x1024 at sigma 32 misses (647 ms). X2 remains deferred; schedule it only if a consumer needs larger grids with wide kernels, with scope limited to yields inside the convolution passes.
